records.process_description: ZEST accepts motivated students for bachelor’s theses, master’s theses, master’s projects and independent studies (linked as PDFs on the page). Eligibility is broadly described as motivated students; new students are treated as junior research members. To apply/secure supervision you must email zest with a recent transcript (courses taken and current/planned), indicate which ZEST publications match your interests and why, and list any other topics you’d consider and why. ZEST will reply and schedule a 25‑minute one‑to‑one meeting; the group assesses your prior knowledge and interests to determine a suitable topic and supervision. The page does not give formal registration steps, deadlines or full administrative requirements; only the linked PDF briefs are provided.
